brief:
GAZA CITY — Palestinians in Gaza are attempting to reconstruct their economic lives despite widespread devastation from conflict, according to Palestine News Network. War has destroyed factories, shuttered businesses, and eliminated livelihoods across the territory. Some residents are working to rebuild using whatever remains accessible beneath rubble rather than starting completely anew.

The scope of reconstruction efforts reflects the scale of economic disruption throughout Gaza, where basic infrastructure and commercial capacity have been severely compromised by fighting. Residents report that rebuilding represents not a return to baseline conditions but an effort to salvage what can be recovered from damaged sites. The process of recovery extends beyond immediate humanitarian needs to address longer-term livelihood restoration for families and small enterprises seeking to resume economic activity.

title: Gazans rebuild livelihoods amid war's destruction
